commodity_alias_resolved_ck.name: commodity_alias_resolved_ck
commodity_alias_resolved_ck.value: ("commodity_aliases"."resolution_status" = 'resolved') = ("commodity_aliases"."commodity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commodity_aliases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

district_alias_resolved_ck.name: district_alias_resolved_ck
district_alias_resolved_ck.value: ("district_aliases"."resolution_status" = 'resolved') = ("district_aliases"."district_id" IS NOT NULL AND "district_aliases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

mandi_obs_nonneg_ck.name: mandi_obs_nonneg_ck
mandi_obs_nonneg_ck.value: ("mandi_observations"."min_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."min_price" >= 0) AND ("mandi_observations"."max_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."max_price" >= 0) AND ("mandi_observations"."modal_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."modal_price" >= 0)

mandi_obs_order_ck.name: mandi_obs_order_ck
mandi_obs_order_ck.value:
("mandi_observations"."min_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."modal_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."min_price" <= "mandi_observations"."modal_price")
      AND ("mandi_observations"."modal_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."max_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."modal_price" <= "mandi_observations"."max_price")
      AND ("mandi_observations"."min_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."max_price" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."min_price" <= "mandi_observations"."max_price")

mandi_obs_price_unit_ck.name: mandi_obs_price_unit_ck
mandi_obs_price_unit_ck.value:
num_nonnulls("mandi_observations"."min_price", "mandi_observations"."max_price", "mandi_observations"."modal_price") = 0
      OR ("mandi_observations"."price_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "mandi_observations"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL)

mandi_obs_arrival_ck.name: mandi_obs_arrival_ck
mandi_obs_arrival_ck.value: ("mandi_observations"."arrival_quantity" IS NULL) = ("mandi_observations"."arrival_unit" IS NULL) AND ("mandi_observations"."arrival_quantity" IS NULL OR "mandi_observations"."arrival_quantity" >= 0)

market_alias_resolved_ck.name: market_alias_resolved_ck
market_alias_resolved_ck.value: ("market_aliases"."resolution_status" = 'resolved') = ("market_aliases"."market_id" IS NOT NULL AND "market_aliases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

markets_merge_ck.name: markets_merge_ck
markets_merge_ck.value: ("markets"."status" = 'merged') = ("markets"."merged_into_market_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "markets"."merged_into_market_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "markets"."id"

markets_coordinates_ck.name: markets_coordinates_ck
markets_coordinates_ck.value:
("markets"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("markets"."longitude" IS NULL)
        AND ("markets"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("markets"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "markets"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

national_price_nonneg_ck.name: national_price_nonneg_ck
national_price_nonneg_ck.value: ("national_monthly_prices"."avg_min_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_min_price" >= 0) AND ("national_monthly_prices"."avg_max_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_max_price" >= 0) AND ("national_monthly_prices"."avg_modal_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_modal_price" >= 0)

national_price_order_ck.name: national_price_order_ck
national_price_order_ck.value:
("national_monthly_prices"."avg_min_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_modal_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_min_price" <= "national_monthly_prices"."avg_modal_price")
      AND ("national_monthly_prices"."avg_modal_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_max_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_modal_price" <= "national_monthly_prices"."avg_max_price")
      AND ("national_monthly_prices"."avg_min_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_max_price" IS NULL OR "national_monthly_prices"."avg_min_price" <= "national_monthly_prices"."avg_max_price")

national_price_price_unit_ck.name: national_price_price_unit_ck
national_price_price_unit_ck.value:
num_nonnulls("national_monthly_prices"."avg_min_price", "national_monthly_prices"."avg_max_price", "national_monthly_prices"."avg_modal_price") = 0
      OR ("national_monthly_prices"."price_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "national_monthly_prices"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL)

national_price_month_ck.name: national_price_month_ck
national_price_month_ck.value: "national_monthly_prices"."period_month" BETWEEN DATE '1990-01-01' AND DATE '2100-12-31' AND extract(day FROM "national_monthly_prices"."period_month") = 1

obs_conflicts_ref_ck.name: obs_conflicts_ref_ck
obs_conflicts_ref_ck.value:
num_nonnulls("observation_conflicts"."mandi_observation_id", "observation_conflicts"."state_observation_id", "observation_conflicts"."national_price_observation_id", "observation_conflicts"."wpi_observation_id") = 1
        AND (CASE "observation_conflicts"."fact_type"
          WHEN 'mandi_price' THEN "observation_conflicts"."mandi_observation_id" IS NOT NULL
          WHEN 'state_observation' THEN "observation_conflicts"."state_observation_id" IS NOT NULL
          WHEN 'national_commodity_price' THEN "observation_conflicts"."national_price_observation_id" IS NOT NULL
          WHEN 'wpi_index' THEN "observation_conflicts"."wpi_observation_id" IS NOT NULL
          ELSE false END)

source_files_period_ck.name: source_files_period_ck
source_files_period_ck.value: "source_files"."reported_period_start" IS NULL OR "source_files"."reported_period_end" IS NULL OR "source_files"."reported_period_end" >= "source_files"."reported_period_start"

state_alias_resolved_ck.name: state_alias_resolved_ck
state_alias_resolved_ck.value: ("state_aliases"."resolution_status" = 'resolved') = ("state_aliases"."state_id" IS NOT NULL AND "state_aliases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

state_obs_nonneg_ck.name: state_obs_nonneg_ck
state_obs_nonneg_ck.value: ("state_observations"."min_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."min_price" >= 0) AND ("state_observations"."max_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."max_price" >= 0) AND ("state_observations"."modal_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."modal_price" >= 0)

state_obs_order_ck.name: state_obs_order_ck
state_obs_order_ck.value:
("state_observations"."min_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."modal_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."min_price" <= "state_observations"."modal_price")
      AND ("state_observations"."modal_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."max_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."modal_price" <= "state_observations"."max_price")
      AND ("state_observations"."min_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."max_price" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."min_price" <= "state_observations"."max_price")

state_obs_price_unit_ck.name: state_obs_price_unit_ck
state_obs_price_unit_ck.value:
num_nonnulls("state_observations"."min_price", "state_observations"."max_price", "state_observations"."modal_price") = 0
      OR ("state_observations"."price_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "state_observations"."price_unit" IS NOT NULL)

state_obs_arrival_ck.name: state_obs_arrival_ck
state_obs_arrival_ck.value: ("state_observations"."arrival_quantity" IS NULL) = ("state_observations"."arrival_unit" IS NULL) AND ("state_observations"."arrival_quantity" IS NULL OR "state_observations"."arrival_quantity" >= 0)

variety_alias_resolved_ck.name: variety_alias_resolved_ck
variety_alias_resolved_ck.value: ("variety_aliases"."resolution_status" = 'resolved') = ("variety_aliases"."variety_id" IS NOT NULL AND "variety_aliases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

wpi_obs_month_ck.name: wpi_obs_month_ck
wpi_obs_month_ck.value: "wpi_observations"."period_month" BETWEEN DATE '1990-01-01' AND DATE '2100-12-31' AND extract(day FROM "wpi_observations"."period_month") = 1
